snippet.title: Ghost Haunting - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020646

Coming soon to PlayStation! Ghost Haunting is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure in glorious low resolution! Puzzle yourself through a world full of ghosts, monsters and pixelated mischief to rescue Gigi's grandmother from the realm of the dead. A heartwarming story about growing up, death, and how the two are connected…

#PS5 #ps5games #ghosthaunting
